integrity: Finite coefficient tables are exhaustively reconstructed by standalone standard-library code, and the infinite-time tail sign follows from an explicit rational inequality and monotone exponential bound; the reported expectation comparison belongs to earlier work.
limitations: The exact distributional sign theorem is restricted to iid uniform line draws in PG(2,3) versus iid uniform four-subsets on the same thirteen points. No claim is made for larger projective planes, all fair mechanisms, or optimal stochastic couplings. Generic inclusion-exclusion underlies the finite calculation. Independent priority review remains outstanding.
title: A single tail-order reversal for projective-plane coupon collection
